title: Leader answer — step-removal-request (stage 3, scope §2.4, E13, review-q0 D7)
description: Common envelope + skip_step. `recommendation.answer` never offers skip (codes.RECOMMENDATION_REMOVED_ANSWERS). ENUM TEMPLATE: values like "{answers}" are placeholders that schema.fill_enums replaces for each call (codes.LEADER_SCHEMA_TOKENS); an enum that comes out empty drops the nearest array or nullable property (read as [] / null). Keeps to type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum (the CLI's structured-output subset). Rules a schema cannot say are checked by gxengine/leader.py (codes.LeaderFormatReason).

answer.description: One of the answers the engine allows for this call (rendered per call). The engine acts on this field only.

reason.description: Leader-decision reason code (§4.2, scope D20). Pick `other` only when no code fits.

step.description: The step to run again — set exactly when answer is rerun, otherwise null.

note.description: Free text for the next role (leader-decision.md), the human and evolve. The engine never branches on it.

recommendation.description: Set exactly when answer is escalate: what you recommend the human answers (scope D15). Otherwise null.

step.description: Set exactly when the recommended answer is rerun.

skip_step.description: The catalog-added step to skip — set exactly when answer is skip, otherwise null (review-q0 D7). `step` stays the rerun target and is always null here.
